answer_1.quote: To assess the multilingual capabilities of MT models, several evaluation benchmarks have been proposed, among which the FLORES+ benchmark has emerged as one of the most prominent.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we employ BLEU and ChrF++ as the evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: All of the annotators have had higher education in English and are currently affiliated with a university.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are instructed to categorize each sentence pair using the following labels: Correct, Wrong grammar, Wrong punctuation, Wrong spelling, Wrong capitalization, Inaccurate addition, Inaccurate omission, Mistranslation, Unnatural translation, Untranslated text, and Wrong register.
